items.name: Lunar occultation of Beta Tauri
items.title: 24 Mar 2026 (17 hours away): Lunar occultation of Beta Tauri
items.summary: The Moon will pass in front of Beta Tauri (Elnath), creating a lunar occultation visible from countries and territories including Brazil, Venezuela, Colombia and Guyana amongst others.
items.note: Event highlight. Excellent visibility (66° max). Best around 17:00.
